title: Signing key: keygen subcommand for transit and reader
description: Implement usenet-ipfs-transit keygen --output <path> and usenet-ipfs-reader keygen --output <path>. Generates random ed25519 seed via OsRng, writes 32 bytes, sets 0600 permissions, prints public key hex and HLC node_id hex to stdout. Refuses to overwrite without --force. Exits non-zero on any error. Blocked on: stoa-3116875c.
